- [FACT] NATS stands for North America Telugu Society, a non-profit organization.
- [FACT] NATS was formed in 2009 by 200 volunteers.
- [FACT] NATS serves Telugu communities across North America through cultural, spiritual, social, and educational activities.
- [FACT] NATS has a 24/7 helpline at 1-888-483-5848 for immediate assistance.
- [EVENT] NATS conducts a bi-annual 3-day convention where approximately 8000 people attend to celebrate Telugu culture.
- [EVENT] The 7th annual convention is planned for May 26-28 at Raritan Convention Center.
- [EVENT] The convention will include cultural, literary, and business symposiums, shark tanks, continuing education classes, women's forums, and career development for the younger generation.
- [EVENT] NATS invites dignitaries and state governors to participate in the main event.
